lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Harlow was dead when I arrived. Someone in this room knew why.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Four guests. Four stories. I had to find the killer, the room, and the weapon.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Stone cold. Nobody made tea tonight.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: That's Harlow answering Vale. He was still alive.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Collar fibres, caught in the braid. I don't like that.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Harlow was going to expose Vale's forged accounts.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Imran's signature. This came from Harlow's coat.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Okafor's handwriting. A bottle she never logged.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Pike's certificate. Rain-spotted, and forged.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I came for the truth. Harlow finally has it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I named the wrong person. The room kept its secret.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The night ran out before my questions did.

lines.speaker: WREN
lines.text: What did Harlow leave us?

lines.speaker: WREN
lines.text: Why are they all so certain where they were?

lines.speaker: WREN
lines.text: What was she doing in a kitchen with a cold kettle?

lines.speaker: WREN
lines.text: How could he answer her if he was already dead?

lines.speaker: WREN
lines.text: What caught those fibres?

lines.speaker: WREN
lines.text: Who can we place in that room, with that cable?

lines.speaker: V
lines.text: Detective. Edmund Harlow. Come tonight. There is something I need you to hear.

lines.speaker: S2
lines.text: Edmund?

lines.speaker: V
lines.text: Vale. I intend to expose your forged trust accounts.

lines.speaker: S2
lines.text: Good night, Detective.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: That proves nothing.

lines.speaker: S2
lines.text: That proves nothing.

lines.speaker: S3
lines.text: That proves nothing.

lines.speaker: S4
lines.text: That proves nothing.

retained.speaker: S2
retained.text: I reached the Study at 22:30. Harlow was already dead.

retained.speaker: S2
retained.text: I met Harlow in the Study at 22:30. The cable was in my hands.

retained.speaker: S1
retained.text: I was in the Hall at 22:30. I stole my debt note before that.

retained.speaker: S3
retained.text: I was in the Kitchen at 22:30. I had borrowed medicine without logging it.

retained.speaker: S4
retained.text: I was in the Conservatory at 22:30. I brought a forged certificate.

retained.speaker: S2
retained.text: I killed Edmund Harlow in the Study with the cable. He was going to expose my forged trust accounts.
